title: SAGE: Salient Factor Discovery and Generation with Visual Foundation Representations
abstract: arXiv:2609.39635v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Given a target dataset, such as faces with eyeglasses, and a background dataset, such as faces without, contrastive analysis separates \textit{salient} factors specific to the target from \textit{common} content shared by both. We aim for salient representations that capture target-specific detail in each image, such as the shape, color, and position of the glasses, so that they reveal subtypes without subtype labels and guide the generation of new examples of a discovered subtype, even one with no name or text description. We introduce SAGE, which learns both factors directly in the high-dimensional spatial latent of a frozen representation autoencoder and conditions a diffusion transformer on the learned salient representation of a reference image. translated_title: SAGE：基于视觉基础表征的显著因子发现与生成
translated_abstract: 给定一个目标数据集（例如戴眼镜的人脸）和一个背景数据集（例如不戴眼镜的人脸），对比分析旨在将目标特有的显著因子与两者共享的共性内容分离开来。我们的目标是获得能够捕捉每张图像中目标特定细节的显著表征，例如眼镜的形状、颜色和位置，从而在无需子类型标签的情况下揭示子类型，并指导生成已发现子类型的新样本，即使该子类型没有名称或文本描述。我们提出了SAGE，它在冻结的表征自编码器的高维空间潜变量中直接学习这两种因子，并以参考图像学习到的显著表征为条件来驱动扩散Transformer。在Digits-ImageNet和FFHQ眼镜数据集上，SAGE将高保真重建（rFID低于2）与无监督子类型发现相结合，对数字的恢复效果优于...
tldr: SAGE在冻结表征自编码器的高维空间潜变量中直接学习显著因子与共性因子，并以参考图像的显著表征条件化扩散Transformer，实现了无需子类型标签的无监督子类型发现与高保真图像生成。
en_tdlr: SAGE learns salient and common factors directly in the high-dimensional spatial latent of a frozen representation autoencoder and conditions a diffusion transformer on the salient representation of a reference image, enabling unsupervised subtype discovery and high-fidelity generation of target-specific content without subtype labels or text descriptions.
